description:
Use this when the user wants a batch of posts planned in one go: "plan my week", "fill my content calendar",
        "draft my top 3 clips for TikTok and YouTube Shorts at my best times". Takes the highest-scoring clips not yet
        posted (RipClip's own clip score) or the clip_ids given, and saves one DRAFT per clip and platform at the
        user's best times to post (evening slots until there is posting data; the answer says which), each with the
        clip's post caption and hashtags. platforms: tiktok, youtube, instagram, facebook, threads, bluesky (Shorts,
        Reels, IG work too; X is coming soon). count 1-10 clips. timezone: IANA name, e.g. America/Chicago.
        Not for: one post with a caption the user chose (draft_post), caption options (write_captions), changing a
        draft (update_draft) or scheduling (update_draft schedule=true, after the user confirms each post). Free. Next: show_drafts displays the calendar.
name: plan_posts
title: Plan posts
